description: This file defines data structures, classes, and constants related to the state of graphical layers and display configurations in Android's SurfaceFlinger component. It includes layer state management, buffer data handling, display state, and related interfaces.

classes.name: TrustedPresentationListener
classes.description: A Parcelable class that holds a callback interface and ID for trusted presentation events.

classes.name: BufferData
classes.description: Represents buffer information for graphical layers, including buffer handle, frame number, and related flags.

classes.name: layer_state_t
classes.description: Encapsulates the state of a graphical layer, including position, size, buffer info, and various flags.

classes.name: ComposerState
classes.description: Holds a layer_state_t instance and provides serialization methods.

classes.name: DisplayState
classes.description: Represents the state of a display, including size, orientation, and surface information.

classes.name: InputWindowCommands
classes.description: Contains focus requests and window info listeners for input command management.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls the callback interface to notify about trusted presentation change.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the object into a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a Parcel.

methods.name: generateReleaseCallbackId
methods.description: Creates a unique callback ID based on buffer ID and frame number.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another state into this one.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Computes differences between two layer states.

methods.name: hasValidBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a valid buffer.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the layer state based on permissions.
